scope.reason: Recompute the signing judge's name from the stored print page: a letter-spaced surname is now joined, and the name has no feature storage of its own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own.
